Thanks for the context — helpful. Quick redwood legal intake notes (initial flags):

- Indemnity & cap: we typically push for a mutual indemnity and a capped liability tied to annualized fees; we can surface a proposed cap for negotiation once procurement confirms ARR/committed spend.
- IP: we need to confirm whether OmniHealth intends to fine-tune Redwood models with customer data; that changes recommended language around customer derivative rights. If yes, tag that on the checklist.
- Data residency / Exhibit D: we can provide the EU-hosted exhibit; if OmniHealth requires dedicated EU-only hosting that will trigger an infrastructure scoping call (possible timeline impact).
- Exhibit ownership/billing: looping in Laura for billing/contact mapping so order form fields are aligned.

Action items for the kickoff call:
- OmniHealth to confirm fine-tuning intent (yes/no) and expected monthly tokens.
- Jonas/Kimberly to confirm whether this should route to Dedicated sales or hosted (depends on volume and residency).
- Redwood legal will provide a redline window estimate during the call and request any procurement-specific PO/contract templates.

I’ll draft an initial redline plan after the call and propose owners for each open item.

Thanks — Irene
